name: Dimension
summary: A simple object consisting of the position and size measurements. Effectively combines [Size](api:Size) and [Point](api:Point) but ensures numeric x/y values.
description:
When a dimension is returned by the [rect](api:Titanium.UI.View#rect) property, `x` represents the
view's left position, and `y` represents the view's top position.

The [size](api:Titanium.UI.View#size) property returns a dimension object with `x` and `y` both set
to 0.

properties.name: x
properties.summary: The x-axis coordinate of the position. When returned by [Titanium.UI.View.rect](api:Titanium.UI.View#rect) the position is relative to it's parent.

properties.name: y
properties.summary: The y-axis coordinate of the position. When returned by [Titanium.UI.View.rect](api:Titanium.UI.View#rect) the position is relative to it's parent.
